question: Find the value of frac{sqrt{729}}{15} times (25)/(sqrt{81)} times (15)/(sqrt{225)}.
solution:
Calculate the square roots:

 

 
• sqrt{729} = 27 (since 729 = 27²)
 
• sqrt{81} = 9 (since 81 = 9²)
 
• sqrt{225} = 15 (since 225 = 15²)

2. Substitute these values into the expression:

(27 / 15) × (25 / 9) × (15 / 15)

3. Simplify:

 
• 27 / 15 = 9 / 5
 
• 15 / 15 = 1

(9 / 5) × (25 / 9) × 1

4. Cancel common terms:

(9 × 25) / (5 × 9) = 25 / 5 = 5

**The value is:** 5
